description:
Find a brand's Wikidata entity and return the URLs to use in Organization.sameAs: the Wikidata page, English Wikipedia, X/Twitter, LinkedIn company, Crunchbase, GitHub, YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, plus its official site and Google Knowledge Graph entity.

Billing: free — Wikidata's public API, no LLM tokens.

Matching is strict: found:true only when a candidate's Wikidata official website (P856) matches `domain` (matched_by:"domain") or you pin an entity with `qid` (matched_by:"qid"). Otherwise found:false with same_as:[] and `candidates` (qid, label, description, official_site, domain_matched) plus a `next_step`: ask the user to supply their brand's profile URLs themselves (Wikidata, Crunchbase, LinkedIn, X, YouTube — 5-10 authoritative ones). Never put a candidate's URLs in sameAs unless the user confirms it is their brand; then call again with its qid.

google_kg is the brand's Google Knowledge Graph entity, same rule: matched by `domain` (its website) or the Wikidata item's KG id, never by name. google_kg_status "not_confirmed" means no KG result could be tied to the brand, not that Google has no entity; Organization schema whose sameAs lists the Wikidata item, and a Wikidata item with the official website and Google KG ID, make it provable. "unavailable": the lookup couldn't run; conclude nothing.

When to call: before writing Organization schema (wp_set_organization_schema), Article.publisher or Product.brand. Always pass domain.

Returns: { found, domain_matched (null without a domain), matched_by, wikidata_qid, label, description, official_site, same_as, detail: { wikipedia_url, twitter, linkedin, crunchbase, github, youtube, facebook, instagram, google_kg }, candidates, google_kg: { kg_id, name, types, description, detailed_description_url, url, result_score, domain_matched, wikidata_id_matched } | null, google_kg_status: matched|not_confirmed|unavailable, next_step? }. A pinned qid whose site doesn't match domain comes back with domain_matched:false and a next_step to confirm with the user.

domain.description: The brand's homepage domain (e.g. moz.com). Needed for found:true unless qid is given.

qid.description: Pin a Wikidata item the user confirmed is their brand, e.g. Q48818116.

name: discover_brand_entities
title: Look up a brand's authoritative entity record on Wikidata and Google's Knowledge Graph
